_about: Every consumable, booster and key item in the slice: ONE source of truth. Battles, the field menu, shops and the sim all read this file. Fields: id, name, kind (heal / juice / revive / cure / rest / throwable / escape / booster / key), desc (placeholder text until M6-2), price (buy price in credits; sells for half, rounded down; 0 = never sold), icon (one of the shared icon ids: food, can, bottle, bomb, key), tint (hex recolor of that icon), target (one_ally / one_down_ally / all_enemies / one_enemy / self / party), use_in (where the Items menu may use it: battle, field, lamp; 'lamp' means the field menu while standing at a save lamp, so the Camp Stove lists only lamp), effect. Effects: heal_hp, heal_hp_pct, restore_juice, restore_juice_pct, revive_hp_pct, cure (status ids), damage (fixed, ignores defense), statuses, escape, rest (full HP and Juice for everyone), boost ({stat: amount}, permanent). Key items have key: true, can never be sold or dropped and are listed on their own tab. Equipment lives in equipment.json.
